ValidationRule.description: Validation rule added to test if the information entered in termination model is depending on the case Model.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( TEXT( Sub_Type__c) ='Terminate ila model', TEXT( Case_Model__c ) ='alburaq') , AND(TEXT( Sub_Type__c) ='Terminate alburaq model', TEXT( Case_Model__c) ='ila') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The informtion entered are not valid; please enter sub Type proper to the model Case.
